name: Edinburgh
source:
Edinburgh is a story of twists and turns in a world of Vampires and Succubi. The war between the two races is centuries old, and now only a few remain. The struggle is to see who will survive. Somehow you the reader, have been dropped down right in the middle of it. 

[Edited from [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=3155758]Patreon[/url]]
